Class Coin

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.Coin
Direct Known Subclasses:
BlueCoin, GoldCoin, PoisonCoin, RainbowCoin, ShieldCoin, SilverCoin, SlowCoin
public class Coin extends Object
Places a reward on an unoccupied board cell and supplies its point value.

      protected Coin(int x, int y, Snake snek, Obstacle obstacle, Point excluded)
      Places a coin on a free cell, excluding one additional position.
      Parameters:
      x - the board width in cells
      y - the board height in cells
      snek - the current snake
      obstacle - the current wall state
      excluded - an additional occupied cell to avoid
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no free cell is available
